With a {item:Shovel}, go to the troll cave in the Premium area of **Rookgaard** ({coord:32001,32213,7}) and use the shovel to go down. Down there always head **south** to the bridge, run across it (the goblins throw stones) and go down the stairs on the other side: you are in the goblin temple.
Entrance to the Premium troll cave (use the Shovel)
Path through the troll cave to the bridge
Get a {item:Pan} from the {wiki:Goblin Temple Quest|Goblin Temple Quest}: at the bottom of the temple climb the stairs to the chest room, kill the monsters and open the chests.
On the way you may meet {creature:Troll|Trolls}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen}, {creature:Goblin|Goblins}, a {creature:Minotaur} and {creature:Wasp|Wasps}.

Go back the same way: temple stairs up, bridge to the **north** and troll cave to the hole you came in by. Use the {item:Rope} to climb back to the surface, near {coord:32001,32213,7}, and head to {npc:Billy}.
Go to {npc:Billy}, on the Premium side of Rookgaard. Say {key:hi}, {key:pan} and {key:yes}.
